title: MEV Sandwich
description: A new threat from 4:00: two bots appear on opposite sides of you with a red line between them and close in at once; step out of the line or get sandwiched for a big hit.

title: Buy the Dip
description: Drop under 30% HP and the screen flashes BUY THE DIP: for 5 s every kill heals you, once per minute (rug pullers and grizzlies ended 58% of Build #15's runs).

title: Horns Uppercut
description: The bull's Horns hit above and below him too from Lv 3, so bears coming from the top of a phone screen get gored (the bull's median run was 6:57, Pepe's 9:38).
